purpose: distinguish a broken forced-choice scorer from a real model failure
verdict: MODEL OUTPUT IS INPUT-INDEPENDENT — shuffling the transcriptomic vectors barely moves the scores, so the forced-choice head is not conditioning on the profile. The low holdout AUC reflects the readout path, not the representation.
caveat: training-set performance is NOT evidence of generalization and is not used as such here; this is a functional check of the readout path only
